$comment: Which original file (in assets/audio/) becomes each sound the web app plays. Rebuild with: npm run audio. Output: apps/web/public/audio/<name>.<format>. Optional: start = seconds cut from the beginning (quiet lead-in), duration = seconds kept, speed = playback rate (1.3 = 30% faster, same pitch), format = 'wav' for short effects (MP3 adds ~25 ms of silence at the start; WAV does not) or 'mp3' (default).
